name: dsh-jev-verify
description: Jev (TypeSafe System One decision model) for DeepSeek Harness — six tools: jev_decision (up to 25 typed questions in one parallel call, measured median 266-484 ms), jev_choose (rank 2-10 approaches), jev_usage (local usage panel: measured calls, tokens, cost, rolling windows and an optional hard budget stop), jev_overview (session ledger), jev_guard_status (auto-guard audit), jev_verify (frozen 27-question live benchmark run 6-way parallel, 4.96 s wall, 96.3% measured). Plus an automatic tool-call guard (10 deterministic rules in two tiers - 7 hard-block, 3 Jev-judged - plus a Jev risk/loop backstop) whose own Jev verdicts are now metered into the usage ledger, an agent/pre-step auto-triage router (0.8.4) that judges each turn's first step and injects plugin-sourced advice so the harness actually calls Jev, system-prompt guidance with mandatory-trigger rules, a GUI settings card, and a money-first composer usage pill that stays silent about quota status and reset countdowns unless a local budget really exists. The /jev mount always answers - a live status page while dashboard.enabled is off. TypeSafe exposes no balance endpoint, so the panel reports only locally measured usage against locally configured budgets - never a fabricated provider balance. Honest by design: no API key means an explicit error, never fabricated results; every registration is quarantined so a failure degrades one feature, never the profile.
